Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer
public final class ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer extends Object
Source-connected professional P&ID scenes, ISO-basis content checks and deterministic pagination.

This renderer consumes the same physical projection as the native DEXPI materializer. Material, sensing and control connections are distinct. Named signal continuations avoid confusing crossed wires with physical junctions. Missing controlled design information is retained as HOLD; it is never supplied from operating values. Drawing-content checks do not constitute independent ISO qualification, safety approval or fitness for construction.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team

    • renderProcessFlowOverview

      public NativeEngineeringDiagramRenderer.Result renderProcessFlowOverview()
      Renders a source-only A1 PFD overview for a small, forward-flow train.

      Up to four primary units are supported. Actual valves, streams and normal operating data are retained; proposed instrumentation is excluded. Branched or reverse-flow arrangements are checked using the same geometry diagnostics as the P&ID, rather than being declared complete merely because a PDF exists.

      Returns:
      native PFD SVG/PDF and geometry diagnostics
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this instance was already used
      IllegalArgumentException - if the source exceeds the supported overview size

    • resolveSignals

      private void resolveSignals(ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer.Scene scene)
      Resolves the signal ends recorded on one sheet.

      IEC 62424 and ISA-5.1 practice draws a signal line directly when both ends are on the same sheet; a named continuation is used only when the peer is on another sheet. Signals whose peer is drawn on this sheet are therefore routed directly as dashed signal lines, and every remaining end receives the reciprocal continuation reference.

      Parameters:
      scene - finished sheet

    • lineNumber

      String lineNumber(String streamName, String ownerTag)
      Returns the drawing line number for a source stream name, resolved against the streams of its owner.

      A stream already named as a controlled line tag (for example 20-PG-001 or 20-FEED-001) keeps its name. Streams with internal simulation names (gasOutStream, 23-KA-001 out stream) receive a NORSOK-style number <area>-<fluid code>-<sequence>: the area is the numeric prefix of the producing (or receiving) equipment tag, the fluid code is PG for vapour-dominated and PL for liquid-dominated process lines, and the sequence is unique per area and fluid code. Every generated number is recorded in the drawing content report with its source stream and is review-required, so line-list ownership stays with the project.

      Parameters:
      streamName - source stream name; names need not be unique in a process
      ownerTag - equipment the label is drawn for, used to pick the right stream
      Returns:
      drawing line number

    • assessDrawingStandards

      private void assessDrawingStandards(Map<String,Object> layout)
      Checks one rendered sheet against the drawing conventions this renderer implements.

      Each violation is a drawing error, so a generated set cannot report a clean drawing while breaking them: ISO 7200 identification fields and revision table; ISO 5457 frame furniture; resolved sheet references with no continuation pointing at its own sheet; line designations instead of internal simulation names; minimum text height of 2.5 mm; and valve symbols consistent with the ISA-5.1 function letters of their tags.

      Parameters:
      layout - rendered sheet layout specification

      Eligible units have one inlet and one outlet, no instrument-detail sheets, no material-path role, and are fed either directly or through a two-inlet header tee. Two-circuit exchangers, fired heaters with more complex topology and units with too many instrument rows keep their own sheet.

      Parameters:
      unit - candidate unit
      Returns:
      true when the unit is drawn on a shared heat-exchanger sheet
